objective: Validate Full, Fixed Sector, and velocity-centred event-recovery Adaptive on seven fixed maps after a body-forward Adaptive blind-side contact in frozen c36.

stages.stage1: repetitions 1-5; all 35 triplets must pass infrastructure/source/heading gates before stage2

heading_policy.adaptive: velocity-centred plus/minus 45 degree acquisition, with certified event-driven Full recovery
heading_policy.aperture_change: none relative to c36; only the Adaptive sector centre policy changes
heading_policy.runtime_audit: Every Sector and Adaptive flight must log exactly one matching SECTOR_HEADING_POLICY marker.

causal_trigger.failed_observation: gapfree_d1_m01 repeat 8 Adaptive contacted cylinder_0168 and stopped at waypoint 2
causal_trigger.interpretation: The body-forward source sector excluded a collision obstacle that lay in the direction of travel; the guard could react only after contact.

unchanged_safety_mechanisms: Full request, fresh frame, committed map ACK, newer certified path, and Sector return handshake remain unchanged. Sixteen-direction certified stopped local escape remains enabled.
blocking_gate: Stop on any infrastructure/source/heading error, or any Full/Adaptive non-completion, contact, speed violation, or strict recovery-audit failure. Retain Sector safety/non-completion as an outcome if otherwise valid.
predeclared_metrics: Adaptive Full-open transitions and refresh acknowledgements
claim_limit: Finite simulation evidence on the declared maps; velocity alignment and Full recovery are both components of Adaptive, so this campaign alone does not isolate their individual causal effects.
